mean_cn: v.对……感到后悔，对...感到遗憾；  n.遗憾；懊悔
mean_en: a feeling of sadness or disappointment that you have because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done
sentence: He regrets that he didn't prepare well for the English exam.
sentence_trans: 他后悔没有好好准备英语考试。
word_etyma: re表强调 + gret哭泣，流泪 → regret后悔
